chunks: Al-Sadiq عليه السلام was asked: How is Laylat al-Qadr better
He عليه السلام said: "Righteous deed in it is better than deed in a thousand months in which there is no Laylat al-Qadr."

key_terms.أَلْفِ شَهْرٍ: a thousand months, indicating an immense span of time used for comparison
key_terms.الْعَمَلُ الصَّالِحُ: righteous deed, an act of obedience and goodness
key_terms.خَيْرًا: better, greater in virtue and reward
key_terms.فِيهَا: in it, meaning within Laylat al-Qadr
key_terms.لَيْلَةُ الْقَدْرِ: Laylat al-Qadr, the blessed night whose worship and righteous deeds carry exceptional merit

ai.seo_question: How is Laylat al-Qadr better than a thousand months according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the meaning of the Qur'anic statement that Laylat al-Qadr is better than a thousand months. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام clarifies that righteous action performed in that night surpasses righteous action done across a thousand months that do not contain Laylat al-Qadr.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2025 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) was asked, "How is Laylatul Qadr better
Imam (as) replied: "Righteous deeds performed on it are better than deeds performed in a thousand months that do not contain Laylatul Qadr."
